newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB falls on report it lost local govt business.
newsitem.headline: DKB falls on report it lost local govt business.

text.p: Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd (DKB) shares fell on Tuesday afternoon, as investors were discouraged by a media report that some local governments were cancelling business with the bank due to its suspected loans to racketeers, brokers said.
As of 0544 GMT, the bank's shares were down 80 yen or 5.63 percent at 1,340, the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Tuesday that three prefectural governments -- Yamagata in northern Japan, Oita in western Japan, and Tochigi near Tokyo -- as well as two cities have withdrawn some or all of their deposits from DKB.
The paper said local governments may take harsher action against the bank depending on future developments in the case.
